verdict.rationale: Belvo documents first-party MCP servers that connect AI agents to its open-finance APIs and install in Cursor and VS Code. That lets an AI-native user drive Belvo through natural-language prompts in an agent client, but the evidence is only two brief mentions, with no detail on what operations the MCP exposes. Missing for 10: documentation of which MCP tools or actions are available, whether the MCP operates the live API or only the docs, a native natural-language interface, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
